original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Prove that no restored closed eight-source word of length 30 has a multiplicity-2 sojourn of rank 3, by exhausting the two arc families that survive the height bound, and record the pair-count floors |Q0| >= 16, 15, 12 at ranks 4, 5 and 6.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a new connector operation. Discussion #1166 comment 19377982 asks whether the existing singleton alphabet has a universal eight-source word of length 30. Upstream pull request 6943 left the rank-at-least-3 case open. This package stays in the published alphabet and closes only the rank-3 case.
bottleneck_link: A universal length-30 word would lower the inherited source-call term f(8) from 32 to 30. Ruling out rank 3 removes one route toward that word. It does not by itself change a recursive supplier moment.
stop_rule: Stop once rank 3 is exhaustively excluded and the rank 4, 5 and 6 pair-count floors are checked. Do not search rank 4 or higher, do not rerun the bent census, and do not treat length 28.
evidence: PROOF.md reduces rank 3 to two arc families and proves the pair-count floors. verify.py exhausts height words of length at most 3, checks the 108 quotient-walk orbits, and compiles rank3_search.c. That search scores 224164584 placements in the five-height family and 9418680 in the four-height family; the minimum number of missed vectors outside the 3-flat is 2.

open_questions.question: Does a universal length-30 word exist when every multiplicity-2 sojourn has rank at least 4, with at least 16, 15 and 12 layer-0 projections at ranks 4, 5 and 6?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A yes answer lowers the upper bound on f(8) from 32 to 30. Rank 3 is no longer available, and the coverage-255 witness still meets the new floors.
open_questions.first_step: Fix one multiplicity-2 source whose open sojourn has rank 4 and whose layer-1 projection has between 8 and 14 points, then search the complementary arc with at least 16 layer-0 projections.
open_questions.blocked_by: The pair count allows those layer sizes, and the recorded witness shows coverage 255, so there is no one-mask counting contradiction yet.

open_questions.question: Does a universal length-28 word with multiplicities (4,4,4,4,4,4,2,2) exist?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It would show the deletion floor 28 is sharp. Together with a negative answer at length 30 it would decide f(8).
open_questions.first_step: Use the fixed-projection matching obstruction from #5430 on one 24-step seven-source projection, without repeating that single-projection exclusion.
open_questions.blocked_by: No length-28 word or exhaustive census is supplied here. This question is reserved and was not searched.
